name: Coulomb Charges
desc: Hundreds of positive and negative point charges drift across a toroidal field and self-organize into glowing ionic lattices, dipole chains and alternating +/- clusters — warm gold cations and cool cyan anions bonded across the whole frame.

energy.doc: glow brightness + charge size (obvious at max)

reach.doc: Coulomb cutoff radius (bigger = more connected lattice)
